page.layout: One page of text, single column, with running head at top; page number at top right. No marginal notes. Final line "Sixti V." is set flush right at the end of the column.

p.i: Dubiè quia sub unius Pontificis jugum universam Ecclesiam redigebat; Bernardi Consiliorum in libris de considerationibus quàm parum memor. Eadem methodus Petri Lombardi, (Is Gratiani frater) in 4. Sententiarum libris, quas ex Patrum locis hinc inde collectis, in certum ordinem compingit, quos & ipse immutato, omisso, addito interdum aliquo verbo, scenæ servire cogit, ad corruptam ævi sui Theologiam inflectit; ut deinceps unus Gratianus consulatur, unus in scholis prælegatur Lombardus; In his tota seu Jurisprudentia, seu Theologia Christiana posita sit; fontem repetere in sacris veteris & novi Testamenti scripturis, in Patrum adeo monumentis antiquiorumve Conciliorum actis, nemo deinde curet; penitius rem introspicere hæresis censeatur.

main_text.p: Huic subjicio judicium Magni Erasmi in libro singulari antibarbarorum. Gratianus de quibusdam quæstionibus in utramque partem disputat, & quidem pari copià, parique facundia: quod idem olim Gorgiam, & Carneadem fecisse legimus. Lectori autem, ubi jam longâ lectione cerebrum vertigine rotari, & caligare acies cœperit, non multò certior surgit, quàm Demipho ille Terentianus, qui ex tribus advocatis consultis, cùm unus suasisset, alter negasset, tertius deliberandum censuisset; Fecistis, inquit, probè, incertior sum nunc multò, quam dudum. Et Hotomanni in Bruto fulmine Sixti V.

page.notes: Printed text is in italic throughout the first paragraph and much of the second. The text ends mid-line; "Sixti V." is set at the right end of the last line. Some words are blurred in the scan (e.g. "Dubiè", "Lectori"), but were read as printed.
